status: study export - proposal, not owner-approved art, not installed in the game

conventions.gltf_axes: glTF +Y up (Blender +Z up converted by the exporter); Blender +Y (piece outward / prop front) becomes glTF -Z

frames.hull.bay: face piece: +X along the face from its start, +Y outward, +Z up; z = 0 is the deck top
frames.hull.corner: convex outline vertex, origin at the vertex on the deck plane
frames.floor: 1 x 1 m cell, origin at the cell's min corner, top at z = 0
frames.int.halfwall/post/doorbeam/threshold: edge piece: +X along the edge, +Y across the wall (centred), +Z up
frames.int.wallpanel/wallbay/rimliner: face-local: hull inner plane at y = -1, dressing extends to more negative y
frames.prop: origin at floor level in the footprint centre (wall props: back on the wall plane), front faces +Y
frames.engine: engine module, origin at the stern face line, +X forward

conventions.materials: slot names (primary, secondary, accent, trim, metal, dark, emit_a, emit_b, glass) recolour with the ship theme; other names are the shared palette; SR_tex_* / SR_decal_* keep their textures
study_only: interior props are placed x1.147 taller in the study (see layout.json matrix_true_scale)
practical lights, bloom and grading are render-time study effects
fx.* exhaust volumes are not exported
